satellitePositionPolicy: v5 merge identity = satelliteGroup + orbitalSlot + satelliteName + frequency + polarity + symbolRate. This prevents accidental merging when multiple physical satellites share one orbital position.

expectedSourceServiceCounts.Nilesat: 7W position pages show hundreds of rows plus 8W companion pages; use live source count, not the bundled fallback, as truth.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Arabsat / BADR: BADR/Arabsat + Es'hail neighborhood; official Arabsat plus KingOfSat/LyngSat baseline-refresh sources.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Hot Bird: 13F/13G position pages list well over one thousand services when TV/radio/data/encrypted rows are included.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Eutelsat 16E: 16E position pages list hundreds of services; bundled fallback is only a safety copy.

expectedSourceServiceCounts.Türksat: 42E includes Turksat 3A/4A/5B/6A; updater imports all published clear/encrypted/radio/data rows.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Yahsat: 52.5E rows are refreshed from LyngSat/KingOfSat plus DTHSat Al Yah 1.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Hellas Sat: 39E rows include LyngSat/KingOfSat plus DTHSat Hellas Sat/Hellas Sat 3 flexible table import.
expectedSourceServiceCounts.Eutelsat 36E: 36E rows include Eutelsat 36D/Express AMU1 references plus DTHSat Eutelsat 36.
